steps.detail: GET environments/status/plugins; require normal mode, idle runtime, action gate closed, other plugins disabled
record environment config, ros2 bindings and plugin enable flags for restore
set ros2 domain 73 and a unique image topic; enable diag_image_probe; select ros2 mode; start runtime
create ONE CompressedImage publisher with sensor_data QoS; no subscriber is created
publish nothing past startup_grace_sec; expect NO_DATA_WITH_PEER (yellow)
publish 12 embedded JPEG frames; expect rx/consume to grow and one recovery event (green)
stop publishing past stale_after_sec; expect a stale warning (yellow)
resume frames; expect a second recovery
stop owned publisher/entry, stop runtime, restore config, bindings and plugin enable flags; each restore is attempted independently

notes: dry-run does not read --token-file, does not write configuration and does not import ROS
each round must run at least 30 seconds and at least 2 rounds must be executed
a round with --with-observer is reported separately and cannot replace a failed no-observer round
results on Windows/mock are NOT_RUN for native ROS; only a Linux instance with Humble can produce a native PASS
